'''System M132L4''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]].

==History==
The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] maintained a drop point, codenamed [[Drop Point: Condor]], in this system, during the height of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
